meta.name: excel-subtotal-audit
meta.description: Audit generated Excel reports by enumerating populated output rows, exposing formulas, and checking that each subtotal range includes all visible detail rows.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审计 Excel 报表的小计行是否覆盖所有明细行
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要检查 Excel 报表中小计公式的准确性
copy.tagline_en: Audit Excel subtotals to ensure all detail rows are included
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to verify subtotal formulas in Excel reports

howto.what: Claude会打开你生成的Excel工作簿，逐行列出所有填充行（包括公式），找出小计行，然后独立计算每个小计应该包含的可见明细行，与公式实际引用的行对比，如果不一致就报告错误。
howto.when: 当你在生成或修改Excel报表后，要求审计该工作簿的小计公式是否正确时触发。

say.text: 请审核我生成的Excel报表，检查小计公式是否涵盖所有明细行。
say.note: 将执行完整的小计范围审核。

say.text: 帮我审计这份财务报表的汇总公式，确保没有遗漏行。
say.note: 会枚举所有填充行并比较范围。

howto.what_en: Claude will open your generated Excel workbook, list every populated row (including formulas), identify subtotal rows, independently derive the expected visible detail rows for each subtotal, compare them to the formula's referenced rows, and report mismatches as failures.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to audit a generated or modified Excel report for subtotal formula correctness, especially for financial statements or rollups.

say_en.text: Please audit my generated Excel report and check that subtotal formulas cover all detail rows.
say_en.note: A full subtotal range audit will run.

say_en.text: Audit this financial statement's sum formulas to ensure no rows are omitted.
say_en.note: Enumerates all rows and compares ranges.
